description: This file defines the NetworkConfig object that manages the base URL for API calls. It ensures the URL has a trailing slash and defaults to a predefined URL if not configured via BuildConfig.

classes.name: NetworkConfig
classes.description: Object that provides access to the API base URL, ensuring proper URL formatting and fallback defaults.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the resolved API base URL, ensuring it ends with a slash and using the default if not configured.
